name: Copywriter
description: Takes high-performing Instagram carousels and posts, rewrites them as slide-by-slide copy with a caption, then hands the brief to an audiovisual specialist to produce the visuals. Written in Portuguese and built around a second bot doing the artwork, so it assumes that pairing exists.

official.title: Copywriter by Gabriel
official.description: Repagina carrosséis e posts de Instagram ranqueados em copy por slide mais a legenda, e envia o briefing para um engenheiro audiovisual gerar as artes....
